what: final collection and failure paths on a ring instance (8 items): an agent that writes submission/ but never submits, an agent that does nothing, an agent stopped by the wall-clock limit
note: 8 items and a 32-run climatology pool: the skill of the 'nosubmit' predictor (an unconditional Gaussian) is within item noise of 0 and decides nothing; the test is about the paths (collection, no predictor -> every item scored as K, wall-clock stop)
